internal-operations-console.purpose: Internal teams triage cases, tickets, accounts, pricing rules, backoffice approvals, and growth operations in one governed desktop console.
qualityGates: Module selection keeps topbar, sidebar, and operations workspace synchronized.
Every operational table, filter, drawer, timeline, approval, and feedback behavior is delegated to patterns.
Growth metrics support owner decisions, support recovery, quality guardrails, and validated operational outcomes instead of decorative dashboard copy.
Growth-brutal and pricing surfaces stay within Surface, density, state, and theme contracts.
agentInstructions: This template is the governed desktop shell for internal product operations.
Use existing operations patterns for cases, tickets, accounts, pricing, approvals, and growth lists; never create local tables, filters, drawers, or feedback banners.
Module selection is the primary controlled/uncontrolled state contract.
rejectIf: Template renders a raw ticket, case, account, pricing, or approval table outside the owning pattern.
Template creates local filter controls, drawers, cards, or feedback surfaces instead of composing Flow patterns.
Template bypasses Surface, density, state, or token ownership.
Template introduces a separate admin shell that duplicates Configuration Console.
